::: {#lem-rss-hessian-vector}
#### Hessian of RSS in vector notation

The [Hessian](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-hessian) of the residual sum of squares is

$$
\deriv{\vcoef} \deriv{\tp{\vcoef}} \text{RSS}(\vcoef)
= 2 \sumin \soprod{\vxi},
$$

and it is positive definite at every $\vcoef$ when $\sspred > 0$ (@def-centered-sums).
:::

::: proof

The Hessian is the solution to @exr-rss-hessian-vector.
The positive definiteness is the solution to @exr-rss-hessian-vector-positive-definite.

:::
